name: Factorio mod
summary: A Factorio mod folder named name_version: info.json, settings, data and control stages, a locale file, with an optional item and recipe.
description: Factorio reads a mod in three stages: settings.lua, then data.lua (prototypes), then control.lua (runtime events). The folder name must be the mod's internal name plus its version, and both must match info.json. This project is that folder.

options.label: Mod name
options.patternHelp: 4 to 41 characters, start with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only

options.label: Author
options.patternHelp: start with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only

options.label: Version
options.help: Part of the folder name. Change it in info.json and you must rename the folder too.

options.label: Description
options.default: One or two sentences about the mod.
options.help: Shown in the game's mod list.

options.label: Factorio version
options.patternHelp: 2.0 or a later 2.x: the files use the 2.0 recipe format and the storage table
options.help: The game version the mod is for. The game refuses a mod made for another one.

options.label: Item and recipe
options.help: A new item with a recipe, added in data.lua, with its name in the locale file.

options.label: Event examples
options.help: control.lua handlers for a built entity and a timer, on top of the welcome message.

next: Start Factorio. The mod is listed under Mods on the main menu.

Prototypes go into data.lua, runtime code into control.lua. Keep the folder name and info.json in step.
